name: What's your wifi password?
source:
"I visited my best friend Gina's house to study for midterm exams.

After a while, my friend went out to get chicken dinner for the both of us, I opened up my phone to use while I wait for my friend, but there's no wifi!

I forgot to ask her for the wifi password. I wonder if I could ask someone else for it?"

[From [url=https://lynis.itch.io/whats-your-wifi-password]Itch.io[/url]]
